content.short: Metrom is a liquidity mining platform for AMMs that incentivizes liquidity providers with ready-made farming contracts.
content.description: Metrom streamlines liquidity management for new DEXs by making it simple to set up incentive programs using native tokens or stablecoins. It provides prebuilt farming contracts, allowing DEXs to reward liquidity providers without building contracts from scratch. For token launches, Metrom designs tailored reward campaigns that help moderate sell pressure and promote market stability, ensuring smooth token distribution and sustained, long-term liquidity growth across the protocol.
